mapper.select: select c.*, case when c.effective_time > #{now} then 'SCHEDULED' when c.expire_time is not null and c.expire_time <= #{now} then 'EXPIRED' else 'ONLINE' end as runtime_status from mall_home_content c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = 'PUBLISHED' and c.effective_time <= #{now} and (c.expire_time is null or c.expire_time > #{now}) order by c.content_type, c.sort_no, c.content_id desc

select c.*, case when c.status = 'DRAFT' then 'DRAFT' when c.status = 'DISABLED' then 'DISABLED' when c.effective_time > now() then 'SCHEDULED' when c.expire_time is not null and c.expire_time <= now() then 'EXPIRED' else 'ONLINE' end as runtime_status from mall_home_content c where c.del_flag = '0' and c.content_type = #{contentType} and c.status = #{status} and c.content_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by c.effective_time desc, c.content_type, c.content_id desc

select c.*, case when c.status = 'DRAFT' then 'DRAFT' when c.status = 'DISABLED' then 'DISABLED' when c.effective_time > now() then 'SCHEDULED' when c.expire_time is not null and c.expire_time <= now() then 'EXPIRED' else 'ONLINE' end as runtime_status from mall_home_content c where c.content_id = #{contentId} and c.del_flag = '0'
select ticker_id as tickerId, content_id as contentId, sort_no as sortNo, label, text from mall_home_content_ticker where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_no, ticker_id
select spu_id from mall_home_content_product where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_no, relation_id
mapper.sql: content_type, content_name, status, effective_time, expire_time, sort_no, hero_eyebrow, hero_title, hero_subtitle, hero_action_text, hero_target_type, hero_target_value, hero_primary_image, hero_secondary_image, hero_new_item_count, recommendation_kicker, recommendation_title, recommendation_target_type, recommendation_target_value, recommendation_display_count, recommendation_fallback_mode
mapper.insert: insert into mall_home_content (, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{contentType}, #{contentName}, #{status}, #{effectiveTime}, #{expireTime}, #{sortNo}, #{heroEyebrow}, #{heroTitle}, #{heroSubtitle}, #{heroActionText}, #{heroTargetType}, #{heroTargetValue}, #{heroPrimaryImage}, #{heroSecondaryImage}, #{heroNewItemCount}, #{recommendationKicker}, #{recommendationTitle}, #{recommendationTargetType}, #{recommendationTargetValue}, #{recommendationDisplayCount}, #{recommendationFallbackMode}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update mall_home_content set content_type=#{contentType}, content_name=#{contentName}, status=#{status}, effective_time=#{effectiveTime}, expire_time=#{expireTime}, sort_no=#{sortNo}, hero_eyebrow=#{heroEyebrow}, hero_title=#{heroTitle}, hero_subtitle=#{heroSubtitle}, hero_action_text=#{heroActionText}, hero_target_type=#{heroTargetType}, hero_target_value=#{heroTargetValue}, hero_primary_image=#{heroPrimaryImage}, hero_secondary_image=#{heroSecondaryImage}, hero_new_item_count=#{heroNewItemCount}, recommendation_kicker=#{recommendationKicker}, recommendation_title=#{recommendationTitle}, recommendation_target_type=#{recommendationTargetType}, recommendation_target_value=#{recommendationTargetValue}, recommendation_display_count=#{recommendationDisplayCount}, recommendation_fallback_mode=#{recommendationFallbackMode}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=now() where content_id=#{contentId} and del_flag='0'
update mall_home_content set status='DISABLED', update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=now() where content_id=#{contentId} and del_flag='0'
